cross_market_insights: The head keyword 'malta wedding' is venue and package intent in Sydney and London (planners, directories, Tripadvisor, UK package sellers). 'malta wedding venues' has the highest volume in both AU (70) and UK (720).

The AI Overview answers the legal question (no residency requirement, RZ1 and RZ2 forms, 6 weeks to 3 months, two witnesses) but cites only UK tour operators and blogs. No government source is cited; identita.gov.mt (Public Registry) ranks only on page 1 of the secondary query, for the religious-marriage page.

Every legal page that ranks is written for UK or Irish couples or by Maltese planners selling paperwork help. Nobody covers the Australian side: Australian documents, apostille, recognition back home, name change, or the marry-in-Australia alternative.
Live forum threads (Facebook Mar 2026, Reddit Nov 2025 and Feb 2026) show the legal question is still asked and answered by strangers.
Cost content is in GBP package prices and 'smart ways to save' framing: wrong currency and wrong tone for an AUD 150K+ reader.
Malta is one of the few European countries in this cluster where the snippets say non-residents can marry with no residency rule; this is the opening answer to confirm from identita.gov.mt.
